Scenario
Because our landfill operations must meet strict environmental regulations, we are required to provide financial assurance (surety bonds, letters of credit, insurance policies or trust deposits) that covers capping, closure, post-closure and certain contract-performance costs.  These instruments appear off-balance-sheet unless a liability becomes probable.

We also disclose our cash-flow information, including a non-GAAP measure called “free cash flow.”  The company defines free cash flow as:  cash provided by operating activities minus purchases of property and equipment plus proceeds from sales of property and equipment, as shown in the consolidated statement of cash flows.  Management discusses year-to-year changes in free cash flow to help users understand liquidity and capital-investment trends.
